_doc: Per-record binding of a variety surface the single document writes as the Spanish state register's name for a cultivar the DO's own regulator (INCAVI) names otherwise — keyed by the ES record slug (a subzona is a deep copy of its parent's parsed roster, so a pin on the parent reaches it) -> normalised surface (lower-case, accents folded) -> {slug, name, reason, source, verified}. The one roster line "MERSEGUERA - SUMOLL BLANCO" otherwise gives two pills (VIVC keeps Merseguera #7660 and Sumoll blanco #12073 apart). A pin whose slug is not in the lexicon fails tests/test_es_grape_context.py. The IT sibling is scripts/_lib/it/grape_context_overrides.json.

merseguera.name: Sumoll blanco
merseguera.reason: The single document's §7 writes "MERSEGUERA - SUMOLL BLANCO": MAPA's variety list (RD 684/2026) gives Merseguera the Catalan synonym Sumoll Blanco, VIVC keeps #7660 and #12073 apart, and INCAVI's pliego names the variety "Sumoi blanco" beside Chenin — the line is one entry, the variety grown is Sumoll blanc.
merseguera.source: INCAVI, Plec de condicions DO Penedès (control de canvis), §6 varietats: "Riesling, Gewurztraminer, Chenin, Sumoi blanco, Viognier, Xarel.lo rosado y Forcada"

merseguera.name: Sumoll blanco
merseguera.reason: §7 writes "MERSEGUERA - SUMOLL BLANCO" (the state register's synonym pair); INCAVI's pliego lists "Sumoll blanco (A)" and no Merseguera.
merseguera.source: INCAVI, PC DO Catalunya modif. 6 (AM07, 2023), variedades: "Chenin blanc (A)", "Sumoll blanco (A)", "Sumoll tinto (A)"

merseguera.name: Sumoll blanco
merseguera.reason: §7 writes "MERSEGUERA - SUMOLL BLANCO"; INCAVI's pliego lists "Sumoll blanco" and no Merseguera.
merseguera.source: INCAVI, Conca de Barberà modificació PC AM05 (2024), variedades: "Chenin", "Sumoll blanco", "Sumoll tinto"

subirat.name: Subirat
subirat.reason: Castelló's single document lists "Subirat" beside "Viura o Macabeo"; MAPA's list (RD 684/2026) gives Alarije the Valencian synonym Subirat Parent, while the bare slug's VIVC pin is Viura (Macabeo) — the card had shown Subirat as a second Macabeo.
subirat.source: Castelló single document §7; MAPA, Variedades de uva autorizadas por las CCAA (2026-09-08), Alarije
